correctness.rationale: PASS. At finite L, uniform attachment/removal makes particle count an autonomous binomial birth-death chain for every positive epsilon. Sectorwise stationary uniqueness and finite-state compactness establish the claimed weak-exchange measure. Strict Newton log-concavity of normalized e_k/choose(L,k) produces strict local MTP2 cross-products when the weights are not all equal; Boolean lattice FKG and MTP2 monotone regression make all distinct pair covariances strictly positive. Fixed-k e_k inclusion/exclusion gives strict negative covariance at 1<=k<=L-1; equal weights give independent Bernoulli. Horizontal detailed balance and vertical ring telescoping prove the explicit genuinely driven subclass; finite-state continuity proves small-positive-rate persistence, not a uniform volume bound. Independently calculated exact rational measures and covariance signs for 20 distinct pairs across four unequal-weight systems; finite tests corroborate rather than prove unrestricted theorem.
